description: Use this to plan an absence for staffId in salonId between startsAt and endsAt. Checks appointment overlaps and the explicit cancelAppointmentIds list, then previews the absence and the specific appointments to cancel. Saves a plan without creating an absence, cancelling appointments or synchronizing the calendar. Applying the absence and listed cancellations requires separate explicit confirmation through beautyos_apply_change.
name: beautyos_staff_absence_create_prepare
title: Prepare staff absence
